# hivelocity_bare_metal_device (Resource)

Provisions a bare metal server from the instant inventory and waits until it is ready. Changing `os_name` reloads the device; the provider removes the device's ports from any VLANs, powers it off if required, waits for the reload and restores VLAN membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_bare_metal_device" "demo" {
  product_id    = 525
  os_name       = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  location_name = "DAL1"
  hostname      = "hivelocity.terraform.test"
  tags          = ["hello", "world"]
  script        = file("${path.module}/cloud_init_example.yaml")
}

output "demo_device" {
  value = hivelocity_bare_metal_device.demo
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname for this device
- `location_name` (String) Deploy device in this location (facility code, for example `NYC1`)
- `os_name` (String) Operating system to install on device. Must match an operating system name returned by the `hivelocity_product_operating_systems` data source.
- `product_id` (Number) Product ID to pick from the stock

### Optional

- `bonded` (Boolean) When set, prefer only bonded devices
- `custom_ipxe_script_contents` (String) Contents of a custom iPXE script to provision the device with.
- `custom_ipxe_script_url` (String) URL of a custom iPXE script to provision the device with (instead of `os_name`).
- `device_id` (Number) Device ID
- `force_custom_ipxe_download` (Boolean) Bypass validation of the custom iPXE script at `custom_ipxe_script_url` and download it regardless.
- `force_device_id` (Number) Force deployment of this Device ID (internal use only)
- `ignition_id` (Number) IgnitionConfig ID
- `last_updated` (String) Last time this device was updated
- `order_id` (Number) Order ID
- `period` (String) Billing period for device: hourly|monthly|quarterly|semi-annually|annually|biennial|triennial
- `power_status` (String) Power status
- `primary_ip` (String) Primary IP of device
- `product_name` (String) Product Name
- `public_ssh_key_id` (Number) ID of a SSH Key to apply for device
- `script` (String) Post-install script for device (cloud-init, Bash for Linux or PowerShell for Windows)
- `service_id` (Number) Service ID
- `tags` (List of String) Tags to apply for device
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `vlan_id` (Number, Deprecated) VLAN ID

### Read-Only

- `app_name` (String) If the device was deployed as an application, the name of the application used.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
